parole.significato: carrot (a plant with a large edible root, often orange in colour, esp. Daucus carota)
parole.testo: The word is first mentioned in Latvian in 17th-century dictionaries. It is a heavily discussed word spread around the Baltic Sea, up to Russian бурка́н (burkán), борка́н (borkán) and Finnish porkkana, Estonian porgand, Livonian borkõn, borkõnz, borkkiņ, the immediate sources of which are unknown but
Borrowed from Baltic German [Term?] which appears to be from Middle Low German kûke, kôke.
